alt_text: App interfaces sit on a preview managed-runtime foundation with governed access and Git-backed versions. Repeatable workflows and exception-handling agents have separate roles. A preview harness hook inspects a tool call before allowing or blocking it, while evaluations and readiness review precede publication.
